name: Broken Blade Rhythm (Combat)
body:
Every blow from your fist builds on the last.

Prerequisites: Broken Blade Style, Broken Blade Crush, Acrobatics 11 ranks.

Benefit: Once per round, when you hit with a Broken Blade strike, you can make a combat maneuver attempt against a creature within your melee reach as a free action. This combat maneuver attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
